from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker = 9 if any(9 in row for row in grid) else 0
    fill = 3
    for r in range(h):
        cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value == marker]
        for left, right in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                out[r][c] = fill
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == marker]
        for top, bottom in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
            for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
                out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''
path=progdir/'task-2662bc94.py'
path.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code, str(path), 'exec'))
print('saved', path)
